member_names: NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit
title: YMC Phases and Associated Methods and Tools
summary: This cluster revolves around YMC, a chemical entity that has two phases: High-DO and Low-DO. YMC is also associated with the Redox cycle and uses Dissolved oxygen. The cluster includes various methods and tools used in conjunction with YMC, such as RNA-seq, which was performed with the Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencing system and the NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit. Additionally, the cluster contains gene or protein entities like DESeq2, GSEA, and STAR, which are likely involved in the analysis of data generated from these methods and tools.
